notes.title: Next-Fest 2024 + Dev Update
notes.content:
[h2]About the demo[/h2]
Hey, this is Pablo, the developper of The Backworlds.

If you see this post because of the Next-Fest, welcome!

I'm really glad of the positive feedback I recieved for the demo released a few months ago and I'm working towards completing the game. 

I'm mostly a one man team and I never sold a game. So It's taking a little while to learn the in and out of the industry in that department and how to best market THE BACKWORLDS.

[h2]Information about the final game[/h2]

I wanted to give you some information about the planned content for the game.

The demo contains basically half of the first level. There are 5 levels planned for the game, so based on the average playtime of people playing through the demo, it would average a total lenght of about 80 to 120 minutes of total playtime, but it should be taken into account that since the game's design makes so you can take a lots of shortcut, it could be significantly shorter for observant players.

[h2]New Enemy[/h2]

In the meanwhile, here is a sneak peak of one of the monsters that I've been working on.

What does it do? [i]What do you think?[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2917360/discussions/]Send me your ideas here!
[/url]

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.2
notes.content:
First, thanks for all the feedback that was given for the Demo!
Here is a small update fixing the most common problems that players faced:

[list]
[*] Tower section reworked for better visibility and difficulty.
[*] Generally added more markings to guide the player through the level.
[*] Fixed a bug where it wouldn’t load the level if you fell out early on in the game.
[*] Default Mouse sensitivity is now lower.
[/list]
